contexts.text: Arteries and veins, called bronchial, which originate from the vena azygos or vena cava, and the aorta. DLW 413:2.
All the states of the lungs depend on the blood from the heart, and from the vena cava and aorta. DLW 412:5.
The heart can be conjoined with the clustering vesicles of the bronchia, also by blood sent out not from itself but from the vena cava and the aorta.
